item.title: Estados Unidos abre la puerta al diésel ruso mientras Trump busca aliviar el repunte de combustibles
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, aseguró que, tras una llamada con su homólogo ruso Vladímir Putin, Moscú suministrará inicialmente cientos de miles de toneladas de diésel, con entregas adicionales en los próximos meses. El anuncio marca un giro en la política de Washington hacia el Kremlin, mientras los analistas cuestionan el impacto de la medida sobre los precios y advierten que los volúmenes y los plazos serían insuficientes para aliviar rápidamente los costos. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: French MPs back bill to tackle sexual and gender-based violence
item.description: In France, a child is reportedly raped or sexually assaulted every three minutes. In a bid to put an end to sexual and gender-based violence, French MPs have voted for a comprehensive bill that could turn into law by the end of the year; it has yet to be debated by the more conservative Senate at the end of the month. FRANCE 24's Aurore Dupuis, who made the documentary "Broken children", tells us how this new law could help improve the situation for women and children in France. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Joni Mitchell becomes US citizen: ‘A journey that began 62 years ago’
item.description: Canada-born singer-songwriter, 82, posts footage of citizenship ceremony to Instagram Joni Mitchell has become a US citizen, after first moving to the country in the mid-1960s. The Canada-born singer-songwriter, 82, posted footage of her citizenship ceremony on her Instagram account, along with a photo of her next to an American flag, accompanied by the caption: “A journey that began 62 years ago.” It means that Mitchell can now vote in US elections, something that she had complained she wasn’t able to do. item.title: France's fed-up youth: Can presidential candidates connect with student movement?
item.description: Will it be autumn recess to the rescue for a beleaguered French government? Ministers no doubt counting the days until Friday evening when the holidays start in hopes that an unexpected student movement disappears as quickly as it materialized. A movement sparked three weeks ago by deteriorating conditions in a Paris area high school may take a leave of absence… but what about demands for a generation that feels left behind by cost cutting? item.title: Elecciones anticipadas en España: ¿cómo se vota y en qué consiste el método D’Hondt?
item.description: España celebrará elecciones generales anticipadas el próximo 29 de noviembre para renovar el Congreso de los Diputados y el Senado. En este país, los ciudadanos no eligen directamente al presidente del Gobierno: votan a sus representantes parlamentarios, y son los diputados del Congreso quienes deciden mediante una votación quién puede encabezar el Ejecutivo. Para entender los resultados electorales, también es importante conocer el método D’Hondt, la fórmula que se utiliza para repartir los escaños del Congreso entre las candidaturas en cada circunscripción.
